grant_crowd_qualification: grant an MTurk qualification to a worker by name and value
revoke_crowd_qualification: revoke an MTurk qualification from a worker by name
bonus_worker: bonus an MTurk worker a specified amount for a given reason and unit
block_worker: block an MTurk worker for a specified reason using a unit or requester
send_feedback_message: send a feedback message to an MTurk worker via email for a task
